docs.description: A Study of History is a landmark work in which Arnold J. Toynbee examines the rise and fall of civilizations throughout history. He argues that civilizations grow when they successfully respond to challenges and decline when their leaders become unable to adapt. By comparing societies across different cultures and eras, Toynbee seeks to identify common patterns in historical development and collapse.
